exposure: stage IB1-IIA2 cervical squamous cell carcinoma
outcome: need for additional postoperative adjuvant therapy
cohort: 144 patients with stage IB1-IIA2 cervical squamous cell carcinoma treated in Wuhan No.1 Hospital from June 2015 to January 2017
finding: History of diabetes, tumor size, FIGO stage >= IIA1, and SCC-Ag >1.5 are independent influencing factors for additional adjuvant therapy after laparoscopic surgery of LACC patients.
